title: Director, Facilities Operations | Healthcare Engineering | $141K–$170K
text:
Description:

**Director 3 – Facilities Operations | Hospital Engineering & Maintenance** 
**On-Site | Towson, Maryland** 
 
Dana G 
Senior Recruiter | Heartline Staffing 
Call or Text: **(314) 526-0706** 
Email: **Dana@heartlinestaffing.com** 
 
**Prefer a confidential conversation instead of applying? Call or text Dana directly at (314) 526-0706.** 
 
**Experienced in hospital facilities operations and ready to lead engineering, maintenance, and infrastructure strategy at a major medical center?** 
 
Heartline Staffing is recruiting a Director of Facilities Operations for an on-site leadership opportunity in Towson, Maryland. This position oversees the daily operations, maintenance, regulatory compliance, and long-term infrastructure planning of a complex hospital environment. 
 
You'll lead multidisciplinary facilities and engineering teams, manage operating and capital budgets, and partner with hospital leadership to ensure safe, reliable building operations. This is a highly visible role with direct responsibility for operational performance, team development, and strategic facilities improvements. 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 

* Direct Daily Hospital Facilities, Engineering, Plant Operations, And Maintenance Activities
* Oversee HVAC, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Utility, And Building Systems
* Lead Skilled Trades, Maintenance Personnel, And Facilities Management Teams
* Ensure Compliance With Joint Commission, CMS, OSHA, NFPA, And Life Safety Standards
* Develop And Manage Preventive Maintenance Programs
* Oversee Operating Budgets, Capital Expenditures, Contracts, And Resource Allocation
* Lead Construction Projects, Capital Improvements, And Infrastructure Upgrades
* Develop Long-Term Facilities And Asset Preservation Strategies
* Manage Vendor Relationships And Service Delivery Performance
* Partner With Hospital Leadership On Safety, Operational Priorities, And Business Continuity
* Oversee Staffing, Performance Management, Coaching, And Team Development
* Identify Opportunities To Improve Building Performance, Reliability, And Operational Efficiency

 
**BENEFITS & CAREER OPPORTUNITIES** 

* Medical, Dental, And Vision Coverage
* Wellness Programs
* 401(k) With Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off And Company Holidays
* Career Development Opportunities
* Tuition Reimbursement

 
**WORK ARRANGEMENT** 

* On-Site In Towson, Maryland
* Hospital Facilities Operations Environment
* Relocation Assistance Not Available
* Visa Sponsorship Not Available

 
Requirements:

**Required Qualifications** 

* Bachelor's Degree Or Equivalent Experience **REQUIRED**
* Minimum 5 Years Of Management Experience **REQUIRED**
* Minimum 5 Years Of Related Facilities, Engineering, Plant Operations, Or Maintenance Experience **REQUIRED**
* Demonstrated Leadership Of Facilities Operations In A Hospital Or Similarly Complex Environment **REQUIRED**
* Strong Technical Knowledge Of HVAC, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, And Utility Systems **REQUIRED**
* Knowledge Of Joint Commission, CMS, OSHA, NFPA, And Life Safety Requirements **REQUIRED**
* Experience Managing Operating Budgets, Capital Expenditures, And Resource Allocation **REQUIRED**
* Experience Overseeing Preventive Maintenance Programs And Vendor Relationships **REQUIRED**
* Experience Managing Construction Projects, Capital Improvements, And Infrastructure Planning **REQUIRED**
* Demonstrated Ability To Lead, Coach, And Manage Multidisciplinary Teams **REQUIRED**
* Strong Financial Management, Communication, And Stakeholder Engagement Skills **REQUIRED**

 
**Relevant Experience** 

* Hospital Engineering And Plant Operations Leadership
* Healthcare Regulatory Compliance And Life Safety Programs
* Management Of Large-Scale Facilities Operations
* Capital Planning And Infrastructure Modernization
* Skilled Trades And Facilities Management Team Leadership

 
Not ready to formally apply? That's completely fine. Many facilities leaders prefer a confidential conversation first. 
**Call or text Dana directly at (314) 526-0706.** 
Email: **Dana@heartlinestaffing.com**
